runs.text: This is a perfectly happy life. Israel is here. Seventy-two out of a hundred. The eighth happiest country on Earth. What's in the gap? Prices: fourth highest of thirty-eight rich countries. Poverty: one in five Israelis. And the war. Israel was fifth in twenty twenty-four. Now it's eighth. Now zoom out. They think Israelis must be miserable. Miserable looks like this: Afghanistan, last in the world, at fourteen. The Emirates and Saudi Arabia, sixty-eight. Kuwait, sixty-five. Turkey, fifty-three. Iran, fifty-two. Jordan, forty-five. Egypt, thirty-nine. Every neighbour is further from a happy life. One honest catch: the Emirates and Saudi Arabia are only four points behind. We're not perfect. We know it. But miserable? We're closer to a happy life than anyone around us.
